name: @vcskill-web/docs
description: Static Next/Fumadocs documentation app. Implementation arrives in Phase 7; this manifest pins its dependency and script surface now so parallel phases never edit the shared lockfile.

scripts.build: node -e "const {existsSync}=require('fs');if(!existsSync('next.config.mjs')){console.log('@vcskill-web/docs: no app source yet (Phase 7 owns it); skipping build');process.exit(0)}require('child_process').execSync('next build',{stdio:'inherit'})"
scripts.check: node -e "const {existsSync}=require('fs');if(!existsSync('next.config.mjs')){console.log('@vcskill-web/docs: no app source yet (Phase 7 owns it); skipping build');process.exit(0)}require('child_process').execSync('next build',{stdio:'inherit'})"
